scope: For nine through thirteen positive primitive natural speeds whose actual real-time loneliness value is at most 1/(k+1), prove the stated squared-norm cutoff and find a listed prime dividing no speed, under the explicit assumption LonelyRunnerBound m for every positive m below k. The basis geometry, KZ product lower bounds, 7,936 subset certificate rows and prime-product estimates are proved internally. This does not discharge the lower-dimensional runner assumptions or prove a higher-speed classification.
